description: This file defines a LocationHandler class in Kotlin that manages location permissions and fetching location data in an Android environment. It includes interfaces for data sources, permission checking, location parameter parsing, and handling location retrieval, with support for testing and error handling.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking location permissions and fetching location data.

classes.description: Implementation of LocationDataSource that interacts with LocationCaptureManager.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles location permission checks, parameter parsing, and location fetching logic, including error handling and testing support.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission.

methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION permission.

methods.description: Main method that manages location request flow, including permission verification, parameter parsing, and calling data source to fetch location, with error handling.
